title: Frame Foot Renewal and Bilge Corrosion Treatment Aft of Frame 62, VANTOR
abstract: Renewal of corroded frame feet and re-treatment of the bilge area between frame 62 and the rear pressure bulkhead on four-engine aircraft, where the aft galley complex and the extended crew rest raise the local moisture load.

sections.reason: The four-engine aircraft carry an aft galley and crew rest arrangement that the twin-engine members of the family do not, and the condensate load in the bilge below it is measurably higher. Scheduled corrosion inspections on twelve VTR-64C3 and seven VTR-68R2 aircraft above 55 000 flight hours found exfoliation at the frame feet between frame 62 and the rear pressure bulkhead on fifteen of the nineteen, in three cases beyond the allowable material loss. The finding is specific to the four-engine cabin layout and the associated drain routing, and no equivalent finding has been raised on the twin-engine aircraft with the same fuselage frames.
sections.description: Corroded frame feet are removed and replaced by the renewal set: the inboard frame skin panel sub-assembly KES742334-41 and the inboard spar cap kit UMB86029-53 are cut back to the nearest sound station and spliced with new material. Silicone edging grommets AES747279-72 are fitted at every systems penetration through the frame web to stop chafe damage acting as a corrosion initiation site. The joint is closed with tension head bolts EN567460-96, self-locking anchor nuts EN581282-4E and solid rivets AGS120161-72, and the systems penetrations are re-grommeted with LN701477-19. The bilge is then washed, dried and treated with a water-displacing corrosion inhibiting compound to the standard practice for surface treatment. Work is done from inside the aft cabin with the floor panels lifted in zones 143 and 146, and from the aft belly fairing in zones 193 and 385. Revised detail is on drawings D53311130915 and D53311135430.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 4.1 kg per aircraft where the full renewal set is fitted, less where only local treatment is required. No electrical load change. The renewal set is not interchangeable with the original frame foot because the splice introduces a new fastener pattern. The corrosion inspection of this bilge area moves from a 3C to a 5C interval once the treatment is embodied and the drain path is verified clear. The removal and installation task for the aft cabin floor panels needs a revised access description, and the SRM material loss limits for the frame foot become inapplicable in the spliced region.
sections.embodiment_note: Retrofit only, through Service Bulletin SLN-53-1030, normally during a scheduled 12-year check when the aft cabin is already stripped. Elapsed time is fourteen days if the full renewal set is needed and six if only treatment is required; the survey step decides which.

type_data.balance_impact: Aft of the reference datum; CG shift below 0.04 % MAC
type_data.production_impact: None; both four-engine lines are closed
